{{Quote|No! Don't open your mouth!|[[Dass Jennir]] to [[Bomo Greenbark]]|<ref name="Republic 79">[[Republic 79|''Republic'' 79]]</ref>}}
A '''flash''' was a physical ability of the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]],<ref name="Republic 79" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]].<ref name="CSWE Nosaurian">{{CSWECite|II|390-391|Nosaurian}}</ref> The flash was a brief<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> but brilliantly bright emission of phosphorescent light from Nosaurians' mouths. Though it possessed no clear evolutionary need, the ability was often used as a method of communication and signalling among Nosaurians since it was completely silent.<ref name="CSWE Nosaurian" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Bomo Greenbark]] attempted to use his flash in order to signal comrades when he was discovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dass Jennir]], but Jennir prevented this from happening. After the two agreed to help one another, Greenbark used the flash to signal to his compatriots in the [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance]] when they approached their base in the [[Forest/Legends|forest]].<ref name="Republic 79" /> Greenbark used the ability once again to illuminate a hole that he and Jennir fell into after the [[Cleansing of New Plympto|Battle of Half-Axe Pass]].<ref name="Dark Times 1">[[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]]</ref>
